DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA

A source for
every step.

SOURCE · COMPARISON · REVIEW

THE REVIEW LOOP

Prepare. Compare. Review.

The initial test stays narrow and permissioned.

01

Prepare the basis

Normalize the specification and quantity from anonymized closed RFQs. Resolve missing units before comparison.

02

Compare and constrain

Show supplier alternatives and lead-time differences, then establish the owner’s non-price negotiation envelope.

03

Review and hand off

Inspect voluntary supplier participation, review the nonbinding draft and prepare a labeled draft handoff. Human signature precedes any binding terms.

EXCEPTIONS & OVERRIDE

Where the comparison
needs a correction.

Juniper’s 30-day delivery differs from the prior 15-day baseline. The owner can choose Delta or document a defensible adjustment. A cosmetic override cannot resolve consent or prohibited terms.

VALIDATION

The pilot ends with evidence.

Measure buyer-reviewed net value, manager hours, omissions and false positives, supplier opt-outs and complaints. The paid pilot decision is a separate real-world commitment.

01

Repeatable category

Choose a low-risk, repeat purchasing job with comparable source records.

02

Named owner

A sourcing lead owns the scope, source review and purchase decision.

03

Authorized envelope

Document permitted terms and prohibited concessions before a draft.

04

Supplier consent

Participation is voluntary, specific and reversible.

A BOUNDED NEXT STEP

Put one category under review.

Start with a permissioned closed RFQ. Agree a named owner, approved envelope and supplier-consented scope before any live pilot.
